From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today to walk through Polaris Tech's search and semantic ranking use case. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps: 

- Current state: you have an in-house ranking pipeline that struggles with latency at >1M queries/day; some relevance drift on new content.
- Goal: improve relevance while keeping 95th-percentile latency under 120ms and reducing per-query cost by ~30%.
- What we showed: Redwood inference runtime (continuous batching + prefix cache), model routing for cost/latency tradeoffs, and per-route observability.
- Success metrics discussed: MRR (relevance) improvement target + latency SLOs + target cost per 1k requests.

Attachments: Polaris-Discovery-Recap.pdf (concise notes + proposed architecture), Redwood-Proposal-SOW-template.docx (baseline SOW).

Next steps (proposed):
1) 30-min tech sync with your infra/ML engineering to validate integration pattern and latency numbers.
2) If aligned, we can scope a 4-week pilot (dedicated pool) and share a draft SOW.

Are you available for a 30-min slot next week (Aug 17–19)? I can coordinate with Neha (cc'd) to find something that works.

Thanks —
Marissa
